result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [Comparison.n_passed]{.doc-object-name .doc-attribute .doc-label .doc-label-property} | Pointblank description: The number of test units that passed. twitter-card: title: >- [Comparison.n_passed]{.doc-object-name .doc-attribute .doc-label .doc-label-property} | Pointblank description: The number of test units that passed. title: >- [Comparison.n_passed]{.doc-object-name .doc-attribute .doc-label .doc-label-property} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: The number of test units that passed. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} The number of test units that passed. ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-attribute} [Comparison.n_passed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} ::: ::: {.doc-text} A test unit passes if its status is `"match"`, which means the row is in both tables with the same values in every compared column (within any tolerance set in [`compare()`](`pointblank.compare`)). If the schema check failed (see [`schema_ok`](`pointblank.Comparison.schema_ok`)), no test unit passes and `n_passed` is `0`, whatever the row statuses are. `n_passed` and [`n_failed`](`pointblank.Comparison.n_failed`) are the counts that [`Validate.tbl_match()`](`pointblank.Validate.tbl_match`) uses for its test units, so they work with the same thresholds and fractions as any other validation step. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Two of these four stations have the same reading in both tables. ::: {#2f078048 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb import polars as pl readings_v1 = pl.DataFrame( {"station": ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4"], "temp": [12.1, 14.0, 9.8, 11.2]} ) readings_v2 = pl.DataFrame( {"station": ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4"], "temp": [12.1, 14.3, 9.8, 11.5]} ) comparison = pb.compare(readings_v1, readings_v2, keys="station") comparison.n_passed, comparison.n_passed / comparison.n ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` (2, 0.5) ``` ::: ::: Half of the test units passed. The two changed rows are available with [`rows("changed")`](`pointblank.Comparison.rows`).
